Primary request: A seamless repeating tile of antique Chinese silk brocade used for scroll mounting: a small dense pattern of interlocking cloud scrolls and tiny rosettes, woven look with fine thread texture, muted and worn, colours only faded ochre #8a6a4a, old teal #4a5a5a and dull gold #a89060. The pattern must tile seamlessly in all four directions. Flat, evenly lit, no folds, no perspective, no shadow, no border, no text.

Delivery composition: intended final aspect 512:512 (512x512 export). Fill every edge with the repeating woven pattern: no empty margins; the design continues seamlessly across all four borders. 
Avoid: text, letters, Chinese characters, inscriptions, seals, signature, frame, border, vignette, photo, 3D, digital gloss. No extra objects beyond the subject. Do not put the filename into the image.

records.name: scholar-window
records.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: scholar-window, a separate bitmap element for a Chinese ink handscroll. Primary request: A round moon window in a white-washed study wall, seen straight on, its frame a thin dark-wood ring; through it a few stalks of bamboo and the corner of a garden rock, painted lightly. The wall itself is bare paper. The window fills about 70% of the canvas.
Backdrop: opaque completely flat grey kraft #b3a994, no paper texture or gradient. Chinese ink wash 水墨: warm charcoal #1e1b17 in many dilutions, softly pooled bleeding ink and dry-brush 皴. Architecture uses fine ruled 界画 in oblique parallel projection showing front and right side, never Western vanishing-point perspective. Match restrained fine ink line weight of existing winehouse and siheyuan handscroll paintings. Colours only as explicitly requested in the subject, all else monochrome. 
Delivery composition: intended final aspect 1000:1000 (1000x1000 export). All subjects complete inside central 76% canvas width and height, with at least12% completely empty flat backdrop on all four sides.

records.name: dusk-mountain
records.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: dusk-mountain, a separate bitmap element for a Chinese ink handscroll. Primary request: One massive towering mountain in the Northern Song manner occupying most of the canvas height, its left flank lit and modelled with light texture strokes, its right side sinking into heavier and heavier ink washes until the right third is near-black wet ink, as if night lies behind it. A tiny path winds up the lit left flank and disappears into a dark cleft. The left, top and bottom edges fade to bare paper; only the right edge may stay dark.
Backdrop: opaque completely flat grey kraft #b3a994, no paper texture or gradient. Chinese ink wash 水墨: warm charcoal #1e1b17 in many dilutions, softly pooled bleeding ink and dry-brush 皴. Architecture uses fine ruled 界画 in oblique parallel projection showing front and right side, never Western vanishing-point perspective. Match restrained fine ink line weight of existing winehouse and siheyuan handscroll paintings. Colours only as explicitly requested in the subject, all else monochrome. 
Delivery composition: intended final aspect 1800:2100 (1800x2100 export). Use a vertical composition with the whole peak and path visible. Exactly the right edge alone may carry dark ink; leave at least 12% flat empty paper at top, bottom and the opposite side. This special edge exception overrides the generic all-side margin. 
Avoid: text, letters, Chinese characters, inscriptions, seals, signature, frame, border, vignette, photo, 3D, digital gloss. No extra objects beyond the subject. Do not put the filename into the image.
Subject restriction: MOUNTAIN AND WINDING FOOTPATH ONLY. No buildings of any kind, no temple, no pavilion, no people. Leave the entire top 15% and bottom 15% completely empty flat kraft. The dark right flank can meet the right edge only inside the central 70% height.

records.name: kafka-library

Fine ruled line work. The building fills about 60% of the canvas width.
Backdrop: opaque completely flat grey kraft #b3a994, no paper texture or gradient. Chinese ink wash 水墨: warm charcoal #1e1b17 in many dilutions, softly pooled bleeding ink and dry-brush 皴. Delivery composition: intended final aspect 1100:600 (1100x600 export). All subjects complete inside central 76% canvas width and height, with at least12% completely empty flat backdrop on all four sides.
